item.title: Off the Menu 2.0.2
item.description: 2.0.2 — Off the Menu for Windows: the full game, native on PC, with in-game self-update (signed feed, in-engine signature verification, swap-and-relaunch). Keep OffTheMenu.exe and OffTheMenu.pck together; first launch needs SmartScreen's More info, then Run anyway. Settings and saves live in %APPDATA% and survive updates.
